nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Your bookmark is still on page nineteen.
nodes.translation: 你的书签还夹在第十九页。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Still there? Has he at least got out of the hotel?
nodes.translation: 还在这儿？他起码走出旅馆了吧？

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: He put his coat on. Then he ordered more tea.
nodes.translation: 外套倒是穿好了。又叫了一壶茶。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I put 'Fast-moving' on the shelf card. Don't look.
nodes.translation: 我在推荐卡上写了“节奏很快”。你别去看。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He opens his own copy, keeping it turned towards himself.
nodes.translation: 他翻开自己那本，书一直朝着他自己。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Twenties? You've hardly got any further than me.
nodes.translation: 二十几？你这不就比我多读了几页吗？

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Twenty-three. I got as far as the bill for the tea.
nodes.translation: 二十三。读到他结茶钱了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Oliver looks at the shelf card. The cat sleeps on.
nodes.translation: Oliver 看了眼架上的推荐卡。猫还睡着。

nodes.speaker: 你的选择
nodes.text: Do you keep reading or give his next pick a chance?
nodes.translation: 再往下读几页，还是看看他下一本能挑出什么？

choices.text: Find out what is holding both of you up.
choices.translation: 看看究竟是什么把你们俩都卡住了。

review.context: Oliver 给一本自己也没读下去的长篇写了推荐卡。
review.outcome: 你们读到被忘下的手套，Oliver 看出了你漏掉的细节，又跟你挤到一起读到了车站。

choices.text: Find something you can finish before the cat wakes.
choices.translation: 找一本能在猫醒来前读完的。

review.context: Oliver 给一本自己也没读下去的长篇写了推荐卡。
review.outcome: Oliver 选了本七页的短篇，猜错结尾。猫踩在末页上，你俩得一起把书翻完。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: You read on. The man pays, but leaves his gloves.
nodes.translation: 你接着念。那人结了账，手套却忘在桌上。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Oh, please don't go back for them.
nodes.translation: 千万别回去拿啊。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: They weren't his. Look at the name sewn inside.
nodes.translation: 那不是他的。你看看里面绣的名字。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Wait. I missed that.
nodes.translation: 等下。这儿我没看见。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Oliver pulls the other chair up to your copy.
nodes.translation: Oliver 把另一把椅子拖到你边上，跟你看同一本。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Read that bit again. From when he puts his coat on.
nodes.translation: 这段再念一下。从他穿外套那儿开始。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: You both stop at the station. The chairs stay together.
nodes.translation: 读到火车站，你俩都停了。椅子还挨在一起。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: He finds a story with seven pages and a missing dog.
nodes.translation: 他找出一篇七页长的小说，讲一只失踪的狗。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: The neighbour took it. Definitely.
nodes.translation: 是邻居把狗抱走了。我敢肯定。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: On page six, the dog comes out from under the bed.
nodes.translation: 第六页，狗从床底下出来了。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: You were so sure about the neighbour.
nodes.translation: 你刚才还说肯定是邻居。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: I was. I'll let you finish it this time.
nodes.translation: 是啊。这回我等你读完再开口。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The cat wakes and steps straight onto the last page.
nodes.translation: 猫醒了，一脚踩在最后一页上。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Oliver lifts one paw. You hold the page flat.
nodes.translation: Oliver 抬起它一只爪子。你按住那页纸。
